results.title: Midnight Sun
results.overview: Katie, a 17-year-old, has been sheltered since childhood and confined to her house during the day by a rare disease that makes even the smallest amount of sunlight deadly. Fate intervenes when she meets Charlie and they embark on a summer romance.

results.title: Suicide Squad: Hell to Pay
results.overview: Amanda Waller's top-secret "Task Force X" — consisting of Deadshot, Bronze Tiger, Killer Frost, Captain Boomerang, Harley Quinn, and Copperhead — is on a mission to retrieve a mystical object so powerful that they're willing to risk their lives to steal it. However, the Suicide Squad isn't the only group of villains seeking to possess the object. It's a race for the golden prize, and second place isn't an option if they want to stay alive.

results.title: Game Over, Man!
results.overview: Three friends are on the verge of getting their video game financed when their benefactor is taken hostage by terrorists.

results.title: Isle of Dogs
results.overview: In the future, an outbreak of canine flu leads the mayor of a Japanese city to banish all dogs to an island used as a garbage dump. The outcasts must soon embark on an epic journey when a 12-year-old boy arrives on the island to find his beloved pet.

results.title: Charming
results.overview: Three fairy tale princesses find themselves engaged to the same guy, Prince Charming.

results.title: The Rider
results.overview: Once a rising star of the rodeo circuit, and a gifted horse trainer, young cowboy Brady is warned that his riding days are over after a horse crushed his skull at a rodeo. In an attempt to regain control of his own fate, Brady undertakes a search for a new identity and what it means to be a man in the heartland of the United States.

results.title: Ready Player One
results.overview: When the creator of a popular video game system dies, a virtual contest is created to compete for his fortune.

results.title: The Titan
results.overview: On a bleak future Earth, a soldier endures a radical genetic transformation to save humanity. But his wife fears he's becoming more creature than man.

results.title: Outside In
results.overview: An ex-con struggling to readjust to life in his small town forms an intense bond with his former high-school teacher.

results.title: Acrimony
results.overview: Faithful wife Melinda, who is tired of standing by her devious husband Robert, is enraged when it becomes clear she has been betrayed. That's when she lost it, and now she cannot let it go.

results.title: God's Not Dead: A Light in Darkness
results.original_title: God's Not Dead: A Light in Darkness
results.overview: Pastor Dave responds to the unimaginable tragedy of having his church, located on the grounds of the local university, burned down.

results.title: Happy Anniversary
results.overview: A quirky couple spends their three-year dating anniversary looking back at their relationship and contemplating whether they should break up.

results.title: The Last Movie Star
results.overview: An aging screen icon gets lured into accepting an award at a rinky-dink film festival in Nashville, Tenn., sending him on a hilarious fish-out-of-water adventure and an unexpectedly poignant journey into his past.

results.title: My Days of Mercy
results.overview: The daughter of a man on death row falls in love with a woman on the opposing side of her family's political cause.

results.title: Honey: Rise Up and Dance
results.overview: Street dancer Skyler comes out of the shadow of her trained dancer sister, Tosha, & joins a dance competition with the Honey dance studio; the prize is a college scholarship.

results.title: A Quiet Place
results.overview: A family is forced to live in silence while hiding from creatures that hunt by sound.

results.title: Don't Worry, He Won't Get Far on Foot
results.original_title: Don't Worry, He Won't Get Far on Foot
results.overview: On the rocky path to sobriety after a life-changing accident, John Callahan discovers the healing power of art, willing his injured hands into drawing hilarious, often controversial cartoons, which bring him a new lease on life.

results.title: Amateur
results.overview: 14-year-old basketball phenom Terron Forte has to navigate the under-the-table world of amateur athletics when he is recruited to an elite NCAA prep school.

results.title: Spinning Man
results.overview: Evan Birch is a family man and esteemed professor at a distinguished university. When a female student goes missing, police Detective Malloy has reason to be suspicious when crucial evidence makes Evan the prime suspect in her disappearance.

results.title: Chappaquiddick
results.overview: Ted Kennedy's life and political career become derailed in the aftermath of a fatal car accident in 1969 that claims the life of a young campaign strategist, Mary Jo Kopechne.
